thread:
rachel: heads up — after pulling my dotfiles on WSL2 today, `redwoodctl login` started failing with 'invalid_grant' during device code exchange. localserve also couldn't start due to profiles.json being a git symlink. anyone run into a symlink + WSL weirdness?

 tom: did you symlink ~/.config/redwood to something under /mnt/c/Users/... ? wsl + windows filesystem can have weird perms and clock differences. what does `cat ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json` show?

 rachel: it's a symlink to ~/dotfiles/.config/redwood/profiles.json (which is on the WSL ext4 root, not /mnt). file contains two entries with same name (merge leftover) and a trailing "<<<<< HEAD" conflict marker. redwoodctl prints a terse 401 and spins.

 jyoti: yeah that explains the parse issue. CLI should fail fast with a parsing error instead of retrying auth. also, check the clock: `date` in WSL vs windows time can be off and that causes token exchange 401 (invalid_grant).

 rachel: ran `date` — WSL shows 2024-11-05 08:12:03, windows shows 08:12:10. i then did `wsl --shutdown` and reopened WSL — clock synced. retried login and still 401. removed the symlink (moved file out), created a clean empty profiles.json, then `redwoodctl login --device-code` worked. localserve now binds.

 infra-bot: Note: ticket DX-5012 created for "improve unreadable profiles.json errors". Suggestion: on parse error redact file and offer `--repair` prompt.

 tom: follow-up: why did localserve fail to bind initially? rachel, what error did it show?

 rachel: localserve error: "EADDRNOTAVAIL: cannot assign requested address 127.0.0.1:7000" — turned out my docker desktop WSL networking had changed host mapping. starting with `redwoodctl localserve --bind 0.0.0.0` fixed it. might be worth adding a note for WSL users in docs.

 jyoti: also logging ideas: on auth 401, include possible causes: malformed profiles.json, clock skew, proxy blocking, or stale tokens. and when configs are symlinked, show the symlink target and git status so users can see merge markers. small DX win. :thumbsup:

 paul: I'll pick up the docs bit and add a troubleshooting checklist: 1) check profiles.json parse/merge markers, 2) check file ownership and symlink target, 3) verify system clock (wsl --shutdown), 4) try --device-code, 5) localserve bind note for WSL/docker.

 rachel: thanks — saved me an hour. attaching the bad profiles.json to DX-5012.
